Store Cloud · Programme tracking · prototype

Printable programme reports

Three report formats for programme 26, built from its live tracking records on 19 Oct 2026: a two-page brief for decision makers, a full report for the file, and a one-page statement each office signs. They use the app's own theme tokens, so they follow whichever theme is selected and always print light.

What the current report misses

  1. A bare headline. "2.3% delivered" has no expected pace, no year-end forecast, no date. The monitor says "On pace" while the forecast finish is 20 Jul 2028.
  2. 48 repeated rows. The same 12 items repeat for each of the 4 codes, with no totals, values or grouping.
  3. No utilisation. The title says "asset utilisation", yet 212 of 220 received assets sit in store and the report never says so.
  4. No offices, risks or audit gaps. The programme requires order documents, but none are attached. No receipt has a supplier recorded.
  5. Not a document. It has no report number, period, data-as-of time, page numbers or signatures, though <x-gs::document> already has slots for them.
Sample data: programme 26 on the local server. Fixture prefixes are removed from names.

How the options compare

A · BriefB · FullC · Office
ReaderHead, director, ministryFile, audit, financeOffice head, storekeeper
Question it answersWill we finish this year, and what must we decide?What has been received so far, where, at what price, and is it in use?Did this office get it, and is it in use?
Length2 pages4 pages at 4 offices; about 30 at 1,000 offices (the office list grows, the rest stays the same)1 page per office
New data neededNone (forecast exists)NoneNone; verification is filled by hand
Build effortSmallMediumSmall

Recommendation: build A and C first. They share the data layer B needs, and they answer the two questions people ask most: "are we on track?" and "did it arrive?" Add B as the "full" format of the same route afterwards.

Building it in the package

  • One TrackingReportService wraps TrackingMonitorService::programme() and adds office slices, asset use, year-end forecast, required run-rate and data checks. Utilisation figures show only where the viewer has inventory access, as the office page does now.
  • One route, initiatives/{id}/report?format=brief|full|office&office=, rendering three views inside <x-gs::document>, using its docNo, date, meta, signatures and footer slots.
  • Print CSS: @page { size: A4 }, page-number margin boxes (Chrome 131+), break-inside: avoid on rows and cards.
  • Every string in lang/en-US/report.php and bn-BD/report.php. Bangla digits are an option for the printed copy.
  • Optional: save each issued report (number, timestamp, data hash) so the QR code can verify a printed copy later.
  • Fix while there: the timeline writes one event per receipt line (12 per goods receipt), and the "On pace" rule ignores a forecast that misses 30 June.
